# Lab 01

## About the Lab

- This lab will be a lighter load than coming weeks.
- We will be focussing on getting people set up with `git` and `R`.
- There are some coding tasks for you to complete if you get started quickly.

## About University Machines

- Where you should save files
- How to open RStudio

## Task 1: Basic Git

- Navigate to [github.com/soton-fds/lab_01_2627](https://github.com/soton-fds/lab_01_2627)
- Follow the instructions on [soton-fds.github.io/github-tutorial.html](https://soton-fds.github.io/github-tutorial.html) to **fork** and then *clone* the repo.
- **When you have a GitHub Username**, input it on Blackboard.

## Task 2-3: Simple Data Analysis

- Open the Palmer Penguins CSV file
- Generate some simple plots
